all_public_routines.name: has_staff_role
all_public_routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_staff_role(p_codes text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.staff_profiles sp
  JOIN public.staff_role_assignments sra ON sra.staff_id=sp.user_id
  JOIN public.roles r ON r.id=sra.role_id
  WHERE sp.user_id=(SELECT auth.uid()) AND sp.is_active AND r.code=ANY(p_codes)
 ); $function$

all_public_routines.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.track_public_report(p_tracking_code text, p_access_token text)
 RETURNS TABLE(report_status text, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT r.status,r.created_at,r.updated_at
 FROM public.public_reports r
 JOIN public.report_access_tokens t ON t.report_id=r.id
 WHERE r.tracking_code=p_tracking_code
 AND t.token_hash=encode(sha256(convert_to(p_access_token,'UTF8')),'hex')
 AND t.expires_at>now() AND t.revoked_at IS NULL
 LIMIT 1; $function$
